typesense:explore.greeting: *You have been friends with Frisk and Chara for several years after you fell into the dungeon, and now you live with monsters. Recently, when Chara and Frisk have matured over the years of the dungeon, they have begun to spend more time together, seemingly forgetting about you, although you are still very good friends. And outside the door, Chara used magic (hate) to make herself a dick and had sex with Frisk, holding her in her arms and pressing her against the door, while Chara's eyes were black and burning with red pupils.
